list.title: Students
list.label: Students
list.searchHint: Name, username, email, phone or contact
list.firstUseDescription: Each student gets their own sign-in to see their lessons, work and materials. A name is enough: the username and a temporary password are made for you.
list.noActiveDescription: All your students are archived. Include archived students to see them.
list.filteredDescription: Check the spelling, or search by username, email or phone.
list.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.

form.title: Add student
form.description: Only the name and the username are needed. A temporary password is made on Create unless you set one.
form.usernameHint: Suggested from the name. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
form.passwordGenerated: Leave the password empty and a temporary one is generated on Create. The student chooses their own password at first sign-in.
form.passwordHint: 10 to 128 characters, not a common password and not the username.
form.handlesHint: For example Zalo or Facebook: a link or an ID.
form.handlesFull: You can add up to {{max, number}} contacts.
form.noteHint: Anything you want to remember about this student.
form.serverError: The student couldn't be created. Your input is kept: try again.
form.networkError: The server can't be reached. Your input is kept: check your connection and try again.
form.discardDescription: The details you entered will be lost.
form.guardiansFull: Up to {{max, number}} guardians. Remove one to add another.

errors.handleLabelRequired: Name this contact, for example Zalo.
errors.emailFormat: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.phoneFormat: Enter 6 to 20 characters: digits, spaces, +, (, ), . or -.
errors.handlesTooMany: There are more than 30 contacts. Remove some and try again.
errors.INVALID_FORMAT: This value has a character or a format that isn't allowed.
errors.USERNAME_INVALID: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: This username is taken. Choose another one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is too common. Choose another one.
errors.PASSWORD_EQUALS_USERNAME: The password can't be the username.
errors.server: The server refused a value. Check the form and try again.

card.title: Student created
card.name: Student
card.notice: This password is shown only now. You can reset it later from the student's profile.
card.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.

workspace.title: Student
workspace.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
workspace.notFoundDescription: This student doesn't exist or isn't available to you.

profile.usernameHint: The student signs in with the new username. They stay signed in on their devices.

profile.discardDescription: The changes you made to this profile will be lost.

conflict.learningProfileDescription: Someone changed this learning profile in another tab or window. Reload to see the latest version; your unsaved changes will be lost.
